sections.content: Expressions of wishes, hopes and desires can introduce the present subjunctive. With esperar que and similar structures, the second clause normally has a different subject.

items.spanish: Espero que todo salga bien porque hemos preparado el viaje con cuidado.
items.english: I hope everything goes well, because we've prepared the trip carefully.

items.spanish: Quiero que llegues temprano para que podamos hablar antes.
items.english: I want you to arrive early so we can talk beforehand.

items.spanish: Ojalá encontremos una solución que funcione para todos.
items.english: I hope we find a solution that works for everyone.

items.spanish: Deseo que tengas tiempo para descansar cuando termine el proyecto.
items.english: I hope you have time to rest when the project is over.

sections.content: Choose the future form according to its function: intention, prediction, wish, condition or expected result.
